submitted.rationale: I measured three compositions near known Cu-vanadate photoanode stoichiometries, each with about 11-12% Fe. The one at a 1:1 Cu:V ratio (the β-Cu2V2O7-like region, index 199) gave the highest photocurrent, 17.9 µA. The CuV2O6-like composition (index 233) gave 15.3 µA and the Cu3V2O8-like one (index 98) gave 4.8 µA. All three merit measurements were spent in one parallel batch, so the result could not be refined afterwards. No XRD was used.

rejected.reason: CuV2O6-like composition: measured 15.3 µA, lower than index 199
Not measured. I gave priority to the known Cu-vanadate photoanode phases.
